payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance differences between CGExpan and LM-Base, particularly in the context of user-generated text versus well-curated benchmarks.

claims.text: CGExpan outperforms LM-Base on well-curated benchmarks but underperforms on user-generated text due to its design that penalizes multifaceted and vague entities.
LM-Base significantly outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text benchmarks, indicating that simpler methods may be more effective in this context.
The performance of SOTA methods like CGExpan does not generalize well to user-generated text, leading to significant performance drops compared to simpler baselines.
